payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-24 (read-only CI log read of 100 main runs 18-23 Oct): the WebKit tablet leg failed 36 times, each a single test. Repeat offenders were the formulation builder walk-through (8), specifier compare swap and map jump (7), and the calculator sheet open (1); the CME phone-scroll and services/on-call failures had already stopped. Cause in traces: the target moves by about a header height between Playwright actionability and the click. Fixed test-side on branch claude/project-thread-q5puw2 by routing those clicks through clickWhenSettled, which now also waits out header hide/reveal and composer-space transitions. Nothing skipped or loosened. Not reproducible in a cloud container: the next WebKit tablet runs on main are the proof; if a failure recurs, pull that run trace first.
